hero.title: Rigor. Structure. Invariants.
hero.subtitle: RIGLAN publishes structured analytical documents. They describe systems through constraints, relations, and limits. Outcomes, actions, and predictions are deliberately excluded.

context.title: What RIGLAN Does Not Do
context.description: RIGLAN does not advise. It does not persuade. It does not recommend. It publishes finished analytical documents that expose structural constraints without interpretation.
